verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1654). The capture verifier refuses a code whose nodeCodeVerdict is refused with bad_signature, and every surface that renders a node code (admin QR studio, /api/qr, /print/qr, Space check-in settings) builds it with signedNodeUrl. The real lib/qr/node-code.ts then proves: a code signed for the node verifies; one signed for another node, one with an edited tag, and one with an edited issue time are refused, inside the grace window too; after 2026-12-01 a bare /n/<id> and the old stored secret are refused; before it both still claim; the grace window ends before launch day; the printed URL carries a code that verifies. Fails on main at the first arm. Exits 79 only when a file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1654). PREMISE RE-TESTED on main at 8b0b1909e: the follow-up line was present, verifyCapture compared ?s= to a stored random nodes.secret only when the node had one, and an /admin/qr code without the toggle claimed from its node id alone. BUILT: lib/qr/node-code.ts signs v1.<issued-at>.<tag>, a 128-bit HMAC-SHA256 over node-code:v1:<node>:<issued-at>, keyed with signingSecret(node-code, [UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET]) (no new env var; throws in production when unset, so it fails closed). verifyCapture refuses a forged, cross-node or tampered code with bad_signature, constant-time. All four node-code surfaces render signedNodeUrl. The per-code Require a signed code toggle is retired (every code is signed) and nothing mints nodes.secret any more; existing secrets stay so old prints keep working. PRINTED CODES: a bare /n/<id> or an old stored secret still claims until 2026-12-01 00:00 UTC and logs [node-code] with the node id each time; after that the scanner sees Couldn’t verify this code, and the fix is a reprint from /admin/qr or the Space check-in settings (same node, same history). OWNER: nothing to add on Vercel. Rotating UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET now voids printed node codes. TESTS: lib/qr/node-code.test.ts, lib/engagement/verify.test.ts (fail on the pre-change verifier), lib/spaces/checkin.test.ts.
